suggestions: I'm grateful for a staging environment that actually caught the bug before it hit prod.
I'm thankful for the imam keeping the khutbah short on a day I had a 9am standup right after.
I'm grateful for roti canai that came out crispy on the edges and soft in the middle, no complaints.
I'm thankful for a manager who said "good catch" instead of asking why I didn't see it sooner.
I'm grateful for the aircon in the LRT working on the one day I wore a full shirt to the office.
I'm thankful for my dad calling just to ask if I've eaten, nothing more, nothing less.
I'm grateful for a merge conflict that resolved itself cleaner than I expected.
I'm thankful for the quiet ten minutes after Isyak before anyone in the house needs anything from me.
I'm grateful for a stranger at the mamak who paid for my teh o ais and just walked off smiling.
I'm thankful for a Jira ticket that got closed because someone else already fixed it upstream.
I'm grateful for the payday notification landing on a day the fridge was actually empty.
I'm thankful for a code comment from six months ago that explained exactly why I did something weird.
I'm grateful for my sister sending a voice note just to complain about her day, trusting me enough to vent.
I'm thankful for the rain holding off until after I parked the motorbike, not a second before.
I'm grateful for a bug report that turned out to be a typo in my own config, easy fix, cheap lesson.
